nifty_filter: Preserve G8: reject only when both completed slot and session directions oppose the trade
vix_filter: Preserve G8: reject LONG when session and recent 30-minute VIX changes are both >= 2%; reject SHORT when both are <= -2%
early_session_fallback: Preserve G8 session-change fallback for the inherited 30-minute direction filter only

risk_permission.decision_time: confirmation_ts, before the original pending entry; size frozen for that order
risk_permission.session_reset: First valid opening observation starts at its indicated risk; missing opening starts blocked. Recovery after a reduction or gap needs consecutive observations.
risk_permission.existing_positions: Never resize, add to, widen stop or change target
risk_permission.quantity_model: Inherited fractional theoretical quantity; separate whole-share sensitivity

selection_basis: User-requested fixed experiment; variants are diagnostics, not an automatic best-history promotion
